program_dir=pathlib.Path(base)/'programs'

program='''def transform(grid):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(rows) for c in range(cols) if grid[r][c] == 3]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
    return [[grid[rows - 1 - r][cols - 1 - c]
             for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)]
            for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
'''
